item.text: [{"severity":"high","issue":"`codex exec --json` emits assistant text in nested `item.completed` events (`event[\"item\"][\"type\"] == \"agent_message\"`, with text in `event[\"item\"][\"text\"]`), so this parser will usually report no text events.","fix":"Handle `item.completed`, validate that `item` is an object, and collect `item[\"text\"]` only for `agent_message` items."},{"severity":"medium","issue":"Concatenating every collected message without delimiters can combine multiple JSON documents into invalid JSON or corrupt adjacent fragments.","fix":"Select the final completed agent message, or define explicit fragment-handling semantics instead of blindly joining all messages."},{"severity":"medium","issue":"The final `json.loads` is unguarded, so empty, malformed, or non-JSON assistant text raises `JSONDecodeError` instead of returning a structured failure.","fix":"Catch `JSONDecodeError` around the final parse and return an error containing safe diagnostic context."},{"severity":"low","issue":"Error events and `stderr` are ignored, hiding useful failure details when Codex terminates unsuccessfully.","fix":"Recognize stream error events and use sanitized `stderr` as fallback diagnostic information when no valid agent response is found."}]
